name: PIER (DC Alliance)

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '1 Martin Place, Canning Vale WA 6155' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Cross-check: the OpenStreetMap building footprint ('Pier Data Centre, 1, Martin Place, Canning Vale, Perth, West') is 29m away.

builder.note: no head contractor named; ECD (source 2) lists vendors incl. Everett-Smith (data centre infrastructure installation), ICM (electrics), Vertiv, Siemens, Cummins; 'designed and constructed within 12 months'

developer.note: built and opened by Pier DC ('wholly WA-owned and -operated'); later acquired by DC Alliance, which now markets it as PIER DC (dcalliance.com.au/pierdc). Acquisition date not confirmed; the DC Alliance acquisition news page now returns 404.

mw_it.note: 'up to 8MW' per Datacentermap/RenewMap listings (aggregators, not read in full). ECD Oct 2017 (read in full) gives no MW figure, only 1000 racks and >2500 m2. Other listings: 6 MW ICT load (Inflect), 2 MW (datacenterHawk).

cost_aud_m.note: ECD: 'The $20 million wholly WA-owned and -operated facility'

construction_start.note: about 2015, since it was 'designed and constructed within 12 months' before starting operations in 2016; exact date not given

construction_end.note: ECD 23 Oct 2017: the facility 'launched operations in 2016'. The Oct 2017 article announced its Uptime Tier III certification, which the earlier record wrongly took as the opening date.

open_questions: scope: launched 2016 (ECD Oct 2017), within the 2016-01-01 cutoff; >= 5 MW rests only on aggregator figures (8 MW RenewMap; 6/2 MW elsewhere) - confirm MW
suburb in master.csv is Perth; actual Canning Vale
